auth_layout.title: Every paddy decision, connected.
auth_layout.subtitle: Manage crops and expenses, act on weather alerts, compare market prices, and complete direct farmer-to-buyer orders.
auth_layout.stack: React · FastAPI · MongoDB · S3-ready image storage

landing.hero_copy: A professional web platform for paddy farmers, buyers, and administrators to manage crop records, market pricing, harvest listings, orders, notifications, and operational visibility.
landing.platform_title: Built for the full paddy operating cycle
landing.platform_copy: Paddy Master brings field data, buyer demand, market prices, and administrative control into one deployable product surface.
landing.surface_title: A dashboard experience ready for daily operation
landing.surface_copy: The application is organized around repeatable workflows: records, decisions, trade, fulfilment, and oversight.
landing.weather_market_visible: Weather and market signals stay visible beside marketplace operations.
landing.workflow_title: From field record to fulfilled order
landing.workflow_copy: Every module supports the next operational decision, so the system works as one product instead of disconnected screens.
landing.deployment_copy: The repository now includes a deploy-focused path for the web surface, API proxying, environment separation, and operational hardening. Stripe subscriptions are available for account billing, while order card payments remain a local demo flow.
landing.cta_title: Launch a more transparent paddy marketplace
landing.cta_copy: Create a farmer or buyer account, or sign in as an administrator after configuring your production environment.

capabilities.records_text: Maintain farms, crop cycles, growth stages, harvest dates, expenses, and field activity from one role-aware workspace.
capabilities.weather_text: Give farmers practical visibility into weather, risk alerts, and crop-care recommendations tied to their operating data.
capabilities.marketplace_text: Let farmers publish harvest listings while buyers compare products, quantities, regional pricing, and seller profiles.
capabilities.orders_text: Track buyer orders, farmer updates, delivery status, payment state, reviews, and notifications through the same platform.
capabilities.prices_text: Publish daily and regional paddy rates so buyers and farmers can make clearer pricing and timing decisions.
capabilities.bilingual_text: Support local usage with bilingual navigation and operating screens for farmers, buyers, and administrators.

surface_points.navigation: Role-protected navigation for farmers, buyers, and administrators
surface_points.production: Production build served by Nginx with same-origin API routes
surface_points.shared: Shared notifications, profiles, orders, reviews, and market data

role_cards.farmers_text: Run crop planning, expense tracking, recommendations, listings, incoming orders, and profile updates.
role_cards.buyers_text: Find verified harvests, compare price and quality signals, place orders, pay, and leave reviews.
role_cards.admins_text: Verify users, moderate products, monitor orders, manage market prices, and review platform analytics.

workflow_steps.record_text: Create farms, add crop details, track growth stages, and keep expenses tied to each season.
workflow_steps.signals_text: Use weather, price, recommendation, and notification data to decide when to irrigate, treat, harvest, or list.
workflow_steps.publish_text: Create a marketplace listing with quantity, district, price, media, and availability for buyers to evaluate.
workflow_steps.close_text: Move orders through payment, fulfilment, delivery, review, and administrative visibility.

deployment_notes.docker: Dockerized React, Nginx, FastAPI, and MongoDB services
deployment_notes.proxy: Same-origin API proxy for production frontend deployments
deployment_notes.cors: Restricted CORS configuration through environment variables
deployment_notes.s3: Private S3 media storage path with local fallback for development
deployment_notes.headers: Health checks, static asset caching, and security headers
deployment_notes.checklist: Clear production checklist for secrets, payments, monitoring, and backups
